title: Jamaican Jewel Rice Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious vegan meal featuring a spicy Jamaican-inspired rice bowl with jewel-toned vegetables.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the snow peas and peas; cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the jewel rice and toned water to the skillet.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 18-20 minutes or until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff the rice mixture with a fork.
